subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: After the merge-helper finding and current-main conflict are fixed, should this Feishu PR receive a maintainer proof override, or should it wait for a live Feishu/CardKit capture?
rationale: The contributor says they lack access to a Feishu tenant plus DeepSeek streaming setup, so the remaining real-behavior gate depends on maintainer access or maintainer acceptance of non-live proof.

options.title: Require repair before proof decision
options.body: Fix the same-prefix final-delta defect and rebase onto current main before deciding whether live proof or a proof override is acceptable.

options.title: Run maintainer live proof
options.body: A maintainer with a Feishu/CardKit setup can capture a redacted live run after the code is repaired.

options.title: Apply proof override after repair
options.body: If a live tenant is impractical, a maintainer can explicitly accept the targeted dispatcher/helper proof once the code finding is resolved.

recommendation.title: Require repair before proof decision
recommendation.body: Fix the same-prefix final-delta defect and rebase onto current main before deciding whether live proof or a proof override is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current live assignee on this PR and is best positioned to decide the proof path or route it to a Feishu owner.
